Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Yakutat Area Office Yakutat, AK 99689

Advisory Announcement For Immediate Release: August 21, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Rick Hoffman Yakutat Area Management Biologist rick.hoffman@alaska.gov (907) 784-3255

YAKUTAT COMMERCIAL SET GILLNET OPENING ANNOUNCEMENT

East Alsek River: will open from 12:01 p.m., Sunday, August 23, through 12:00 noon, Wednesday, August 26, 2026.

Alsek River: will be open from 12:01 p.m., Sunday, August 23, through 12:00 noon, Wednesday, August 26, 2026.

Dangerous River: will be open from 12:01 p.m., Sunday, August 23, through 12:00 noon, Wednesday, August 26, 2026.

Yakutat Bay: will be open from 12:01 p.m., Sunday, August 23, through 12:00 noon, Wednesday, August 26, 2026.

Situk-Ahrnklin Inlet: will be open from 12:01 p.m., Sunday, August 23, through 12:00 noon, Wednesday, August 26, 2026, with the following restrictions:

Lost River: will be closed to commercial set gillnet fishing north of a line from an ADF&G regulation marker located at 59°27.38′ N lat, 139°36.55′ W long (approximately 500 yards southeast from the Lost River-Situk Inlet confluence) to a regulation marker at 59°27.82′ N lat, 139°37.46′ W long (approximately 600 yards northwest from the Lost RiverSituk Inlet confluence);

Situk River mouth (including upstream of Johnson Slough): will be closed to commercial set gillnet fishing west of a line from an ADF&G regulation marker located at the eastern bank of Johnson Slough at 59°26.73′ N lat, 139°33.25′ W long, to a buoyed regulation marker located at 59°26.33′ N lat, 139°34.15′ W long, to a regulation marker west of the Yakutat Seafoods buying station at 59°26.69′ N lat, 139°34.55′ W long on Sunny Point;

Chinook salmon retention: the Situk River commercial set gillnet fishery is closed to the retention of Chinook salmon. Chinook salmon of any size may not be retained for sale or personal use. Chinook salmon found dead in the net must have the dorsal fin removed immediately and recorded on a fish ticket at the time of landing. On the fish ticket, the number and weight of the fish must be recorded and the disposition code ‶86-Donated″ must be used. Retained Chinook can either be delivered to a buyer at the time of sockeye salmon sale or to the Yakutat ADF&G office for distribution to those in need in the community.

Lost River: will remain closed until further notice.

Manby Shore-Outside Waters: will be open from 12:01 p.m., Sunday, August 23, through 12:00 noon, Wednesday, August 26, 2026.

Manby Shore-Inside Waters: will be open from 12:01 p.m., Sunday, August 23, through 12:00 noon, Wednesday, August 26, 2026.

Remainder of the Yakutat District: will be open from 12:01 p.m., Sunday, August 23, through 12:00 noon, Wednesday, August 26, 2026.

Yakataga District: will be open from 9:00 a.m., Sunday, August 23, through 9:00 a.m., Wednesday, August 26, 2026.

Yakutat Set Gillnet Week 35

August 21, 2026

Yakutat Set Gillnet Week 35 August 21, 2026 Kaliakh River: will be open from 9:00 a.m., Sunday, August 23, through 9:00 p.m., Monday, August 24, 2026, and 10:00 a.m., Wednesday, August 26, through 10:00 p.m., Thursday, August 27, 2026.

Kaliakh River: the Tsiu River delta at the confluence of the Tsiu and Kaliakh Rivers and the eastern bank of the Kaliakh River across from the Tsiu River delta will be closed. The closure extends 100 yards from the Tsiu River delta beginning at but not including the edge of the upriver extent of the Tsiu River delta.

Tsiu River: will be closed.

Seal River: will open from 9:00 a.m., Sunday, August 23, through 9:00 a.m., Wednesday, August 26, 2026, with the following restriction:

Seal River: waters of the Seal River will be closed upstream of the confluence of the East Fork tributary of the Seal River (located downstream of Vitus Lake).

Dual Permits: The use of dual permits is being allowed in the Situk-Ahrnklin Inlet and Yakutat Bay north of a line from Point Manby to Ocean Cape. Individuals are reminded that if going to fish with two permits they are to notify the Yakutat Fish and Game office when they plan to begin fishing with two permits and when they stop fishing with two permits.

The Emergency Order corresponding to this announcement is EO 1Y1526.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
